look_here_first: Look for long hanging curtains of slender silver-gray stems and tiny curved leaves; inspect the tiny scales, greenish flowers, and growth on branches as an epiphytic bromeliad, not a lichen.
photo_note: Temporary one-photo learner coverage. Keep until stronger diagnostic gallery coverage replaces or supplements it.
identification_caution: This is an epiphytic bromeliad rather than a true moss or a parasite; source may be geographically outside project area.
